agreement.heading: Agreement
p: These Terms of Service ("Terms") govern your use of Manilo (formerly Ledgy) — the iOS app, web dashboard at dashboard.manilo.app, the Manilo Telegram bot, and related services (the "Service"). By creating an account or downloading the app, you agree to these Terms. If you don't agree, don't use the Service.
The Service is operated by the team behind Manilo, hereinafter "we" or "us".

account.heading: Your account
p: You are responsible for everything that happens under your account, including keeping your sign-in credentials safe. Only one person may use a single account; sharing your login defeats the purpose of group sharing (which is built in and free with Cloud).
You must be at least 13 years old (or 16 in the EEA) to use the Service.

subscription.heading: Subscription & payment
p: Cloud is offered as a recurring subscription, billed monthly or yearly. The price shown at checkout is the final price you pay. Subscriptions are processed by Apple through your App Store account.

subscription.cancel: You can cancel at any time in Settings → [Your Name] → Subscriptions on iPhone.

trial.heading: Free trial
p: New subscribers may receive a 7-day free trial. You will not be charged until the trial ends. If you cancel before the trial ends, you owe nothing. The trial is offered once per Apple ID.

p: Features marked "Beta" inside the app are experimental, may produce incorrect output, and may be removed without notice.
